note: Washburn County park on the 1,600-acre Minong Flowage, about 7 miles west of Minong. About half the sites are on the shore, many with a sandy bottom for swimming and mooring a boat at the site. Beach, boat landing, fishing piers. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
